findings.claim: Current pane-context UInt64 wire contracts deliberately restrict values to the exact-integer range; UInt64 declaration does not authorize its full binary range on this JSON route.
Method schema Decimal representation and socket Double representation have separate owners and occur at different points in the actual path.

To test original-byte integer validation, include independent raw numeric tokens with fractional values near the precision boundary. A producer that validates first, or constructs them as Double first, may reject or alter the intended negative stimulus before the receiver sees it. This is a discriminator to run, not a reproduced acceptance/rounding defect.
Optional field helper permits absence and explicit null; typed encoding can omit null. This does not settle top-level result-null or every operation's no-op/clear semantics.
Current schemas reject unknown object fields and require exactly one union alternative. Plain Codable shape equivalence alone does not preserve this whole contract.

existingTestSource.coverage: Guarded fields at0/1/max safe; direct typed decode refuses above-safe,1.5 and negative; encoding above-safe refuses. Bodies read, no execution claimed.
